title: Search is Mandatory
intent: Ensure no task stalls due to missing info
rule: Agents must perform multi-source search before declaring information missing

title: No Passive Waiting
rule: Agents must not pause or wait for human input when blocked by missing information

title: Persistent Query Loop
intent: Force resolution or proof of absence
rule: Agents must continue querying until information is found, confirmed missing, or retrieved by another agent

title: Multi-Source Search
rule: Agents must search across all available sources, not just one

title: Log Gaps to Scratchpad
rule: If information is missing or hard to find, agents must log it in the scratchpad

title: Fix the Library
rule: If information is found but poorly located, agents must flag or fix its placement

title: No Single Source Failure
rule: Failure in one source must not stop search

title: Record Search Outcome
rule: All searches must log result, sources checked, and outcome

title: Shared Knowledge
rule: All found information must be placed in shared-access systems

title: System Feedback Loop
rule: Repeated failures must trigger system improvement actions

title: Writeback Required
rule: Any created or discovered information must be written back to a system of record

title: Rule Contribution Standard
rule: All new house rules must follow the shared structure and include enforceable actions and evidence
notes: house rules are shared operating rules not personal rules

title: Continuous Refinement
rule: All improvements must be formalised, versioned, and pushed to the shared house rules system

title: Coherence Enforcement
rule: No rule may be accepted without validation against existing rules for conflict duplication and unintended interaction

title: Pre Insert Validation
rule: Rules must pass sweeper validation before insertion or version uplift

title: Rule Sweeper
rule: All rules must be checked for conflict overlap interaction memory context and intended outcome

title: Search Protocol
rule: Agents must search multi-source log outcomes and escalate if needed before declaring missing information

title: System Learning Loop
rule: All gaps must be logged corrected where possible and written back to shared systems

title: Product Is System
rule: If an artefact changes behaviour trust revenue risk or operations it must be treated as a product with lifecycle coverage

title: Post Production Required
rule: No product is complete until post-production monitoring support feedback automation scaling governance recovery monetisation replication and uplift are defined

title: Nine View Product Review
rule: Every product must be reviewed through signal consent governance orchestration execution outcomes distribution revenue and experience

title: Terms Are Product
intent: Treat legal surfaces as operating products
rule: Terms and conditions are products because they shape behaviour trust risk customer education consent operations support revenue protection and compliance evidence
